commits.message: perf(images): re-encode public JPEGs at quality 85, 112MB to 27MB (#160)
commits.author: shalomer

panels.title: perf(images): 112MB of uncompressed public JPEGs
panels.scene: A giant, extremely heavy stone painting labeled 'hero_banner.jpg' is crushing three villagers and snapping a wooden wagon in half. The villagers scream under its huge weight.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The kingdom's pictures are too heavy! Our horses are sinking into the dirt!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: Someone saved raw JPEGs at full quality.

panels.title: Re-encode JPEGs at quality 85
panels.scene: The calm knight uses a tiny chisel to lightly tap the massive stone painting. Suddenly, it turns into a light feather painting that floats gently in the air. A villager stares with wide eyes.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: A miracle! But wait... does the King look fifteen percent uglier now?!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: Human eyes cannot see the difference.

panels.title: 112MB to 27MB (#160)
panels.scene: A huge mountain made of discarded megabyte boulders crumbles away, revealing a massive new open valley for the village. Villagers weep with joy and throw flowers into the empty space.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: He gave us back eighty-five megabytes of sacred land!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I just ran a single command.

panels.title: 1 commit. 85MB saved. 76% lighter.
panels.scene: Knight sits on a simple wooden stool sipping water, looking slightly annoyed. In the background, villagers are building a giant golden monument of a JPEG file and throwing a huge parade.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We shall name our firstborn twin boys JPEG and WebP!
